title: The feed as a small library
description: Start by seeing a feed as a list of labelled cards. Read the Post shape and seed data, then follow pure functions that publish, filter, merge, and count records. Keep display concerns out of these transformations.
learning_objectives: Explain post records, seed fixtures, and pure feed operations in plain language.
Trace export function canPublish in `src/feed.ts` and explain the relevant behavior.
State and preserve this limit: Posts are local sample records; mergeRemotePosts is a helper and does not itself call a network.
concepts: Post records, seed fixtures, and pure feed operations
